# CPU smoke fixture

`model.pth` is an untrained, randomly initialized RVC v2 F0 checkpoint with
768-dimensional content input, one speaker and 16 kHz output. It exercises the
real adapter and trainer, not voice quality. It contains no recordings or
downloaded weights. The posterior encoder is omitted as in an RVC export.

Generated by a private maintainer script with the Python 3.10 VC engine and the
RVC source pinned in `vc_worker/engine-manifest.json`.

Seeds are fixed at 15 for Python, NumPy and Torch; CPU initialization uses one
thread and deterministic algorithms. CI downloads the pinned RVC source, HuBERT
and RMVPE using the existing installer's SHA256 verification before loading them.
Run `python -m pytest -m slow tests/test_vc_cpu_smoke.py` in the engine environment
with `AI_VOICE_VC_RUNTIME` pointing to the directory containing `spike/`.
